notes: Chronogram 'gaṃdharvvajaivātrikasarpyamāne' (corrupt for -sarpa-māne): gandharva = horse = 7, jaivātrika = moon = 1, sarpa = 8. Read right to left this gives 817. No era is named. NS is assumed from the Newari script, so 817 + 880 ≈ 1697 CE. This is not certain: read as VS 817, the year would be impossibly early for Mallinātha, who lived in the 14th–15th century. Calendar check, not done: Svātī on a kṛṣṇa caturthī with the sun already in Meṣa looks astronomically awkward, so the date details may be garbled. Bhūmideva wrote the copy 'cirāya' (to last) after bowing to Maheśa's lotus feet. The opening invocation is to Nārāyaṇa, Nara and Śiva. The scribe matches the catalogue field 'Bhūmideva ?'. Kolacala is Mallinātha's family name.
